searchedEmpty: DoH NI: per-trust unit costs for 2022-23, 2023-24 and 2024-25 are not published (NI averages and trust total expenditure only). The latest per-trust figures are the 2019-20 Community Services Indicators.
DoH NI: no separate child protection unit cost in any year. The nearest lines are Gateway (per UNOCINI assessment) and Family Support & Intervention (per case).
DoH NI: no separate cost per placement for independent fostering agencies.
DoH NI 2024-25: the Gateway, Court Children's and Adoption Orders lines and the separate kinship/non-kinship lines are absent (fostering merged incl. kinship, per case).
DoH NI: no adoption unit cost after 2022-23 (absent from the 2023-24 and 2024-25 files).
YJA/DoJ/CJINI: no stated cost per youth conference (YJA 2024-25 and 2025-26 accounts and CJINI report listings checked).
NI: no stated cost per youth court case (DoJ/NICTS).
NIAO: no stated cost of a child in care, or of care-experienced outcomes.
DE/EA: no published cost per statutory nursery school place (funded through the CFF; only the AWPU and the voluntary/private PSEP rate are stated).
DE/EA/NIAO: no stated cost per special school place (NIAO 2017 SEN report gives totals only).
DE/EA: no stated EOTAS cost per pupil.
EA Youth Service: no stated cost per member or per young person.

PSSRU Unit Costs 2024 (Jones et al., 2025, incl. the 12 Oct 2025 amendment, read via Wayback copy of the KAR PDF): NO children's services section and NO Northern Ireland adjustment. Children's home, foster care and children's social worker costs last appear in the 2021 manual.
PSSRU Unit Costs 2025 manual: not checked. The KAR repository returned 504 throughout and no archive copy was found.
HACT Social Value Bank: current (v7, 2025 prices) outcome values are not public (licensed calculator only). No Northern Ireland variant found.
Foundations: no per-child or unit cost of late intervention published; the 2016 analysis gives aggregates only. No NI edition found.
GMCA Unit Cost Database: no Northern Ireland figures; each entry is England, England and Wales, or UK.
